additions.content:
{
  "localizer.description": "Makes indentation easier to read",
  "localizer.configuration.title": "Indent-Rainbow configuration",
  "localizer.includedLanguages": "For which languages indent-rainbow should be activated. When empty will use for all languages.",
  "localizer.excludedLanguages": "For which languages indent-rainbow should be deactivated. When left empty will ignore.",
  "localizer.ignoreErrorLanguages": "For which languages indent-rainbow should skip indent error detection (use '*' to deactivate errors for all languages).",
  "localizer.updateDelay": "The delay in ms until the editor gets updated.",
  "localizer.indentSetter": "Automatically change indent settings for languages (see README.md for details).",
  "localizer.errorColor": "Indent color for when there is an error in the indentation, for example if you have your tabs set to 2 spaces but the indent is 3 spaces. Can be any type of web based color format (hex, rgba, rgb).",
  "localizer.tabmixColor": "Indent color for when there is a mix between spaces and tabs in the indentation. Can be any type of web based color format (hex, rgba, rgb) or a empty string(to be disabled this coloring).",
  "localizer.ignoreLinePatterns": "Skip error highlighting for RegEx patterns. Defaults to c/cpp decorated block and full line comments.",
  "localizer.colors": "An array with color (hex, rgba, rgb) strings which are used as colors, can be any length.",
  "localizer.colorOnWhiteSpaceOnly": "If error color is disabled, indent colors will be rendered until the length of rendered characters (white spaces, tabs, and other ones) is divisible by tabsize. Turn on this option to render white spaces and tabs only.",
  "localizer.indicatorStyle": "Classic mode uses a full colored tab to indicate the indendation. Light mode will only display a colored border similar to the default indent guide lines. You can disable the default indicators with `#editor.guides.indentation#`.",
  "localizer.lightIndicatorStyleLineWidth": "This property defines the indent indicator lineWidth when using light mode.",
  "localizer.indicatorStyle.classic": "classic",
  "localizer.indicatorStyle.light": "light"
}

{
  "localizer.description": "通过彩色缩进让代码层次更易阅读",
  "localizer.configuration.title": "indent-rainbow 配置",
  "localizer.includedLanguages": "启用 indent-rainbow 的语言；留空时对所有语言启用。",
  "localizer.excludedLanguages": "禁用 indent-rainbow 的语言；留空时不排除任何语言。",
  "localizer.ignoreErrorLanguages": "跳过缩进错误检测的语言（使用 '*' 可对所有语言禁用错误检测）。",
  "localizer.updateDelay": "更新编辑器前的延迟时间，单位为毫秒。",
  "localizer.indentSetter": "自动修改指定语言的缩进设置（详见 README.md）。",
  "localizer.errorColor": "缩进错误时使用的颜色，例如制表符宽度设为 2 个空格，而实际缩进为 3 个空格。支持任意网页颜色格式（hex、rgba、rgb）。",
  "localizer.tabmixColor": "缩进中混用空格和制表符时使用的颜色。支持任意网页颜色格式（hex、rgba、rgb）；设为空字符串可禁用此着色。",
  "localizer.ignoreLinePatterns": "跳过匹配指定正则表达式的错误高亮。默认跳过 C/C++ 装饰性块注释和整行注释。",
  "localizer.colors": "用于缩进着色的颜色字符串数组（hex、rgba、rgb），数组长度不限。",
  "localizer.colorOnWhiteSpaceOnly": "禁用错误颜色后，缩进颜色会一直渲染，直到已渲染字符（空格、制表符等）的长度能被制表符宽度整除。启用此选项后仅为空格和制表符着色。",
  "localizer.indicatorStyle": "经典模式使用整块颜色表示缩进；轻量模式仅显示彩色边框，类似默认缩进参考线。可通过 `#editor.guides.indentation#` 禁用默认参考线。",
  "localizer.lightIndicatorStyleLineWidth": "轻量模式下缩进指示线的宽度（lineWidth）。",
  "localizer.indicatorStyle.classic": "经典",
  "localizer.indicatorStyle.light": "轻量"
}
